name: bridge_domains
desc: List of bridge domains. - Map key: `fabric_encap` - The Layer 2 bridge-domain Fabric encapsulation (VNID). Possible values are `unknown`, `vlan-XX` or `vxlan-XX`.

name: bridge_domains[*].access_encap
desc: The Layer 2 access encapsulation (VLAN or VNID). Possible values are `unknown`, `vlan-XX` or `vxlan-XX`.

name: bridge_domains[*].admin_state
desc: admin state. - Choices: `suspend`, `active`

name: bridge_domains[*].bridge_domain_state
desc: Bridge Domain State can be active or suspended. - Choices: `suspend`, `active`

name: bridge_domains[*].bridge_mode
desc: The Layer 2 bridge-domain parameter mode used by the node for enabling classical bridging or bridging with the IP address. - Choices: `ip`, `mac`

name: bridge_domains[*].control
desc: The control state. - Choices: `none`, `untagged`, `policy-enforced`

name: bridge_domains[*].cross_connect
desc: Enable Cross Connect on VLAN. - Choices: `disable`, `enable`

name: bridge_domains[*].forwarding_control
desc: The Layer 2 bridge-domain forwarding controls. - Choices: `mdst-flood`, `arp-flood`

name: bridge_domains[*].forwarding_mode
desc: The Layer 2 bridge-domain parameter mode used by the node for enabling forwarding modes. - Choices: `route`, `bridge`

name: bridge_domains[*].isolate
desc: Enable Layer 2 isolation on this VLAN. - Minimum NX-OS version: `10.6(3)`

name: bridge_domains[*].long_name
desc: Enable or disable long name of 128 characters for VLAN.

name: bridge_domains[*].mac_packet_classify
desc: Vlan mac packet classify. - Choices: `disable`, `enable`

name: bridge_domains[*].mode
desc: Vlan mode. - Choices: `CE`, `FabricPath`

name: bridge_domains[*].name
desc: The name of the object.

name: bridge_domains[*].vrf_name
desc: Enable or disable vrf name of 32 characters for VLAN.

name: deletion_policy
desc: What happens on the device when objects managed by the resource are removed. `delete` deletes the object on destroy, including any configuration not managed by Terraform, and deletes single child objects once none of their attributes are configured anymore, unless the device holds other entries below them. `reset` deletes the objects created by the resource on destroy, resets the managed attribut…

name: device
desc: A device name from the provider configuration.

name: svi_autostate
desc: Disable/enable autoState for SVI interface. - Choices: `disable`, `enable`

name: vlan_configurations
desc: List of `vlan configuration` stanzas. - Map key: `access_encap` - The Layer 2 access encapsulation (VLAN or VNID). Possible values are `unknown`, `vlan-XX` or `vxlan-XX`.

name: vlan_configurations[*].mac_learning
desc: VlanMacLearn state. - Choices: `disable`, `enable`
